items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: And, uh, we made some records with, uh, Benny Goodman, Fats Wara, some of the finest records Lewis made.

ctx.x: Can you tell me about, uh, Pollack? You say he wanted to sit in, what was that story?

Oh, that was, uh, when, one time he used to hang around the Friars a lot. In fact, uh, Benny Goodman, all the kids were going to Austin High School, and they used to, couldn't come in, so they'd sit on the outside and listen. So one time, uh, he heard, Benny heard his, Pollack heard his, uh, talking about Snyder, couldn't make it, and he walked up to me and he says, uh, do you mind, Mr. Bruins? He says, if I sit in, I says, uh, how do you play? He says, oh, he says, I play pretty good. I says, well, all right,…
What kind of a place was Fires in? Was it in the basement?
